text:
alex (Partnerships): Quick team update 
BlueMantle Logistics is officially live on Azure Marketplace with our connector + dedicated deployment option. Listing went public at 07:12 UTC. :shipit:

marketplace-bot: Listing published: Azure Marketplace  region(s): westeurope. partner_id=BLUEMANTLE-77. URL: https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/items/blue-mantle-redwood-connector

mika (Sales): Love it 
Huge congrats! Any quick stats from their pilot we can share internally?

alex (Partnerships): Pilot highlights: 30% reduction in average cost-per-inference when using our dedicated pooling + autoscaling. Their throughput jumped 3x under peak routing. Internal case draft: https://redwood.internal/partners/bluemantle/case-draft (internal)

dev (Eng): Tech note: Bluemantle's workload is heavy on embeddings for routing (50k req/day). We enabled adaptive batching plus per-tenant memory caps to avoid noisy-neighbor OOMs. P95 improved from 340ms -> 180ms.

priya (Product): Nice metrics. Can we get a 1-line quote from their Head of ML and a screenshot of the dashboard? Want to feature this in next week's marketplace digest.

mika (Sales): Reached out to their Head of ML (Marco). He agreed to a short quote and a dashboard screenshot. ETA: today.

alex (Partnerships): Marketplace co-sell status: confirmed by bizops. I'll attach the co-sell tag and contract pointer once I get the signed doc.

marketplace-bot: Co-sell eligibility set: TRUE. Contract ref: https://redwood.internal/contracts/BLUEMANTLE-77 (internal)

dev (Eng): Sharing the ops snippet we used (internal):
```
deployment:
  mode: dedicated
  pool: bluemantle-prod
batching:
  adaptive: true
  max_batch_ms: 10
resource_limits:
  per_tenant_gpu_mb: 20480
routing:
  fallback: lowest_cost_variant
```

priya (Product): Perfect 
Alex, please publish the partner page when contract is attached. Mika, follow up on quote. Dev, please add that config to the case appendix. Thanks all 
This is a solid marketplace-to-dedicated conversion story.

mika (Sales): Will do 
I'll push the quote and screenshot to the draft today.

alex (Partnerships): Thanks team! :tada: I'll post the public case link when ready and share social assets.
